description: Implement a turn-based Driver-Navigator pair programming workflow. One agent (Driver) focuses on implementation and writes code, while the other (Navigator) reviews, validates, and suggests improvements in real time. Roles can swap dynamically based on tasks. Triggers: "페어 프로그래밍", "공동 작업", "드라이버 네비게이터", "pair programming", "driver navigator", "collaborative coding".
